summary: Verified trial-unlimited chat fix for user_id=default. POST /api/chat/send returns 200 with non-empty LLM response and is_unlimited=true/messages_remaining=999 across 5 back-to-back messages (no paywall). GET /api/subscription/status confirms tier=trial, is_premium=true, is_unlimited=true, messages_limit=999. Full pytest suite (test_subscription_chat.py + test_subscription_trial.py) 25/25 PASSED against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend /coach loads, accepts input, calls /api/chat/send, and renders French coach reply with no 'reached your limit' or upgrade block. Regression: /sessions, /training, /progress, /subscription (trial banner) all render without paywall interference (confirmed in iter_27 and unchanged).

issues: Event Date uses native browser date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a shadcn/ui Calendar component - inconsistent with the dark-themed UI

critical_code_review_comments: Chat quota logic recognizes trial/early_adopter/premium as unlimited - mirrors /subscription/status fix. Consider extracting the tier->is_unlimited resolution into a single helper (subscription_tier_resolver) to avoid future drift between the two code paths.

messages_used counter still increments on unlimited plans (current value 18+ for default). Not a bug given messages_limit=999 gating, but worth documenting or skipping the increment for unlimited tiers to keep telemetry clean.
seed_data_creation: None (only default user; a handful of chat messages sent as part of end-to-end verification against the real Emergent LLM).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trial=unlimited chat fix confirmed both at API and UI. Default user is on active 30-day trial; chat send returns is_unlimited=true. All 25 subscription/chat pytest cases green. Canary chat curl: POST /api/chat/send with X-User-Id: default. Sample workout for AI analysis regression remains garmin-23473184085.
rca of the issue: PRE-FIX RCA: /api/chat/send quota block only accepted Stripe status=='active' as premium. Trial users (subscription_status='trial') fell through to the Free tier with 10-message cap, so once messages_used reached 10 the endpoint returned a 'reached your limit' error. FIX: added elif branch treating trial/early_adopter/premium as unlimited (tier_config unlimited=True, messages_limit=999). Verified by curl (5 msgs) + pytest (25 passed) + UI send on /coach.
